mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 62 degrees and clear near the Verona Public Library. The air quality index is 53, and we have a beautiful full moon out tonight. If you are a night owl, you can see the ISS rise in the West Northwest over Cross Plains at 3:26 AM, heading toward the Northeast near the Home Depot while staying low near the horizon.

The city has a few important updates today. Mayor Diaz has proclaimed September 2026 as both Hunger Action Month to help combat food insecurity and Suicide Prevention Month to raise awareness. Additionally, today is Building Inspector and Code Staff Appreciation Day to honor our local guardians of public safety.

Today is packed with local fun, including the Dane County Farmers Market and live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Verona Area High School hosts the Kids Triathlon, and the Verona Ice Arena is holding a free Girls Try Hockey event.
In our weekly look at service calls, on August 17, officers successfully located and arrested a 21-year-old man on Cross Country Road following a request from the Department of Corrections.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Mint Explosion. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so stop by and enjoy a scoop.
